entries.title: Data hosting and access location restriction
entries.summary: AtliQ must host personal data exclusively in Microsoft Azure West Europe (Netherlands) with remote access from India permitted under SCCs, and may not transfer personal data outside the EEA without Corvina's prior written consent.
entries.quote: Personal data shall be hosted only in Microsoft Azure West Europe (Netherlands). Remote access from India by AtliQ personnel is permitted under the EU Standard Contractual Clauses (Module 2, controller-to-processor) incorporated in Annex 2-C. No other transfer outside the EEA is permitted without Corvina's prior written consent.

relatedClauses.quote: Categories: retailer contact data, Corvina employee data (sales force), loyalty-card panel data supplied by retail partners (pseudonymised).

entries.endRule: Initial 3-year term ending 22 March 2029, auto-renewing annually

entries.title: 36-hour data breach notification
entries.summary: AtliQ must notify Corvina of any personal data breach without undue delay and within 36 hours of becoming aware of it.
entries.quote: AtliQ shall notify Corvina of a personal data breach without undue delay and in any case within thirty-six (36) hours of becoming aware of it.
entries.endRule: Initial 3-year term ending 22 March 2029, auto-renewing annually

entries.title: 30-day sub-processor change notification
entries.summary: AtliQ must inform Corvina in writing at least 30 days in advance of adding or replacing any sub-processor, giving Corvina an opportunity to object.
entries.quote: AtliQ shall inform Corvina in writing of any intended addition or replacement of a sub-processor at least thirty (30) days in advance, giving Corvina the opportunity to object.
entries.endRule: Initial 3-year term ending 22 March 2029, auto-renewing annually

entries.title: Annual data protection audit
entries.summary: AtliQ must permit Corvina to audit its compliance with data protection obligations once per year upon 30 days' advance notice.
entries.quote: Corvina may audit AtliQ's compliance once per year on thirty (30) days' notice.
entries.endRule: Initial 3-year term ending 22 March 2029, auto-renewing annually

entries.title: Post-termination data deletion or return
entries.summary: AtliQ must delete or return all personal data within 30 days after termination of the agreement.
entries.quote: On termination, AtliQ shall delete or return all personal data within thirty (30) days.
